purpose: Teach: 後遺症/火葬/引き起こさ/漏らし/退去/服従/脱退/揶揄

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、長期療養者の後遺症ケアを医療チームで担当しております
lines.en: Ren — we handle long-term post-recovery care management as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Slight pause between name and statement to mark professionalism. Steady eye contact. No apology in the voice, but no coldness either.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、火葬前の遺体検案を医療チームで実施します
lines.en: Yes — we conduct post-mortem examination before cremation as a full medical team.
lines.style: Same steady cadence. Clinical precision without detachment. A pause before the main clause, like she's ensuring accuracy. Breath controlled.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感染症を引き起こさせた水質問題の研究を、貴院、なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital has conducted research into the water contamination that caused that infection outbreak, sensei?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, respectful lean forward. Not accusatory — truly asking. A small uptick at the end like he's inviting her to share more. Warm but careful.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、個人情報を漏らした事案の再発防止を医療チームで強化しております
lines.en: Yes — we've strengthened our protocols as a team to prevent any repeat of that data breach incident.
lines.style: Calm, factual. A micro-pause on 'strengthened' — not defensive, just anchoring the word. Still meeting his gaze. Professional composure held steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 入院患者の早期退去を、貴院、なさる方針なんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital does follow a policy of early discharge for inpatients, sensei?
lines.style: Thoughtful, not interrogating. Quiet underlayer of concern. Pacing slightly slower, like he's choosing words with care. Sincere interest, not suspicion.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、絶対服従を求める医療には医療チームで疑問を呈します
lines.en: Yes — we question whether medicine should ever demand absolute obedience. That's core to how we work as a team.
lines.style: Slight firmness on 'question' — conviction without aggression. Breath steady. She's stating principle, not defending. Eye contact unwavering but warm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 学会から脱退した医師の心情を、貴院、ご理解されてるそうですね、先生
lines.en: I understand you show compassion for physicians who've left their professional associations, sensei?
lines.style: Careful respect in every syllable. Slower pace. He's asking something vulnerable — this matters to him. Hopeful but guarded tone, like he's testing safety.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者を揶揄する発言は医療チームで厳禁としております
lines.en: Yes — we have a strict policy against any mocking or dehumanizing language toward patients. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. No drama, but absolute. Slight close on the final word — she's drawing a line. Tired underneath, but the resolve is firm and clear.
